representation: Fresh Morgan fingerprints, independent logistic and random-initialized neural models
groups: Connected components of development-only Morgan Tanimoto >= 0.6 graph. All assay records of all held-out molecules are excluded at every fitting boundary.
ablation_policy: D6-only network auxiliary loss weights zero; multiassay uses .3 other binary and .2 continuous auxiliary weights
threshold_policy: Inner OOF bootstrap mean MCC, no positive-count budget
motivation: Exact Murcko scaffolds yielded 1450 distinct labelled groups for 1497 D6 labels; enforce actual molecular-neighbor separation instead
excluded_inputs: Every prior model, score, call count and representation weight. Source molecule and assay tables only.
